Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:11:1.english: And all of the benefit is his - For he was doing his work with it without any payment.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:11:2.english: Due to [his] statement - [That is, the statement] of "I hereby pay."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:11:3.hebrew: לא מקני ליה - הבעלים כפל, שאין זו שום טובה. מוטל היה עליו להניח דעתו, שהשאילה לו חנם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:11:3.english: He does not transfer to him - The owner [does not transfer] the double payment [to him], for this is not any favor. It was incumbent upon him to put [the owner's] mind at ease, since he lent it to him free of charge.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:13:1.hebrew: ללישנא קמא דר"פ - ודאי לא הוי תיובתא, דנימא: כיון דטעמא דרב פפא משום דלא הוה למפטר נפשיה, דהא מתה מחמת מלאכה לא שכיחא, אפי' קדם ושילם נמי אית ליה לרב פפא דלא קני ליה כפילא, ותיקשי ליה. הא ודאי ליכא לאותובי, דמצי אמר לך: אנא "אע"פ שאמר הריני משלם" אמרי, ולא אמרי "אע"פ ששילם":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:13:1.english: According to the first version of Rav Pappa - [It] is certainly not a refutation, [such] that we would say: since Rav Pappa's reason is because [the borrower] was not [paying] to exempt himself — for [an animal] dying due to work is not common — even if he went ahead and paid, Rav Pappa also holds that he does not acquire the double payment, and [thus the baraita] would be a difficulty for him. This certainly cannot be raised as a refutation, for he can say to you: I said, "even though he said, 'I am paying,'" and I did not say, "even though he paid."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:13:2.english: Shall we say it would be a refutation - Shall we say that the Tanna of the baraita means "he paid" specifically?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:16:1.hebrew: והא מדקתני - תנא דברייתא גבי שוכר "ואמר", כדאמרינן לעיל "תניא כוותיה דר' יוחנן", וגבי שואל "ושילם", בהך ד"תניא כוותיה דרב זביד":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:16:1.english: And from [the fact] that [he] teaches - [that is, the] tanna of the baraita [teaches] with regard to a renter, "and he said," as we said above [in the passage], "It was taught in accordance with Rabbi Yochanan"; and with regard to a borrower, "and he paid," in that [baraita] of "It was taught in accordance with Rav Zevid."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:17:1.english: They asked them - The members of the academy [asked].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:17:2.hebrew: לתנאי - שהיו שונין תוספתא דרבי חייא ותוספתא דרבי אושעיא, שהם עיקר, כדאמרינן בעלמא (חולין דף קמא.): כל מתניתא דלא מיתניא בי רבי אושעיא ורבי חייא, לא תותבוה בי מדרשא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:17:2.english: To the tanna'im - Who would recite the Tosefta of Rabbi Ḥiyya and the Tosefta of Rabbi Oshaya, which are authoritative, as we say elsewhere (Chullin 141a): "Any baraita that was not taught in the school of Rabbi Oshaya and Rabbi Ḥiyya, do not cite it in the study hall."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:1:1.hebrew: מי יימר דמגנבא - שעתיד להיגנב, דליקני ליה כפל בשעת מסירה, דעל כרחך משעת מסירה בעי לאקנויה, שמשכה ממנו על מנת כן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:1:1.english: Who could say that it will be stolen - [Who says] that it will be stolen in the future, such that he [the owner] could transfer the double payment to him [the bailee] at the time of delivery? For perforce he must transfer it to him from the time of delivery, since he [the bailee] drew it [into his possession] from him on this condition.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:1:2.hebrew: נעשה כאומר לו - בשעה שמסרה לו, דקים להו לרבנן דניחא להו לבעלים שיהא בטוח בקרן על מנת שיהא ספק כפל העתיד לבא של שומר. והרי היא כמסרה לו על מנת כן, שאם תיגנב וישלם לו קרן, שתהא פרה קנויה לו משעה שמסרה. נמצא למפרע, כשגנב הגנב, של שומר היתה, דפרה כבר היא בעולם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:1:2.english: It is as though he said to him - At the time he handed it over to him, for the Sages ascertained that it is pleasing to the owner to be assured of the principal on condition that the potential double payment that will accrue in the future belong to the bailee. Thus, it is as if he handed it over to him on this condition: that if it is stolen and [the bailee] pays him the principal, the cow shall be acquired by him from the time he handed it over. It emerges retroactively that when the thief stole [it], it belonged to the bailee, for the cow is already in existence.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:2:1.hebrew: אי הכי - דנמצא שהיתה שלו משעה ראשונה, יזכה אף בגיזות וולדות שהיו לה משבאה לביתו, דכיון דנגנב ורצה ושילם, נמצאת שלו למפרע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:2:1.english: If so - [Meaning] that it turns out that it was his from the first moment, [and therefore] he should also acquire the fleece and offspring that it had from when it came to his house, for since it was stolen and he was willing and paid, it turns out to be his retroactively.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:3:1.hebrew: פסקא - פסקת הדבר בכל אדם, שדעתו להקנות כפל אם יבא לכך, ואין דעתו להקנות הולדות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:3:1.english: Categorical rule [pesaka] - The fixed determination of the matter for every person — that his intention is to transfer [ownership of] the double payment if it comes to that, and his intention is not to transfer [ownership of] the offspring.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:4:1.english: It is as though he says to him - at the time he handed it over to him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:4:2.english: When it will be stolen, and you will wish, and you will pay me - If you pay me the principal.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:4:3.hebrew: סמוך לגניבתה קנויה לך - שעה אחת לפני גניבתה תהא הפרה קנויה לך, והיא כבר היתה בעולם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:4:3.english: Adjacent to its theft, it is acquired by you - One moment before its theft, the cow shall be acquired by you, and it was already in existence.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:5:1.hebrew: קושיא דר' זירא - ללישנא בתרא, ליכא לאקשויי גיזות וולדות, דהא סמוך לגניבתה הוא דאקנייה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:5:1.english: The difficulty of Rabbi Zeira - According to the latter formulation, one cannot raise the difficulty [concerning] fleece and offspring, for it is just before its theft that [the owner] transferred ownership to him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:5:2.hebrew: א"נ דהוה קיימא באגם - כשגנבה גנב, ללישנא בתרא לא קני כפילא, דהא סמוך לגניבתה לא היתה בחצירו שתהא חצירו קונה לו, ומשיכה ההוא שעתה לא הואי, ובמאי נקני? וא"ת: תקני לו משיכה ראשונה שמשכה לו על מנת לקנותה שעה הסמוכה לגניבתה? הא אמרינן בכתובות בהאשה שנפלו לה נכסים (דף פב.): האומר לחבירו משוך פרה זו ולא תיקני לך אלא לאחר שלשים, לא קנה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:5:2.english: Alternatively, where it was standing in a marsh - When a thief stole it, according to the latter formulation [the bailee] does not acquire the double payment, for just prior to its theft it was not in his courtyard so that his courtyard could acquire [it] for him, and there was no pulling [meshikhah] at that time; so by what [means] would he acquire [it]? And if you should say: Let the initial pulling — when he pulled it for himself on condition to acquire it at the moment just prior to its theft — acquire [it] for him, [we answer that] surely we say in Ketubot, in [the chapter] HaIshah SheNaflu Lah Nekhasim (82a): One who says to his fellow, "Pull this cow, and let it not be acquired by you until after thirty [days]," has not acquired [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:8:1.hebrew: השוכר פרה ונגנבה כו' - אע"פ שהשוכר חייב בגניבה ואבידה, מ"מ אם רוצה לשקר ולישבע שנאנסה, היה נפטר בשבועה. הלכך, כי אמר נגנבה וחייב עצמו בקרן, נקנה לו הכפל:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:8:1.english: One who rents a cow and it was stolen, etc. - Even though the renter is liable for theft and loss, nevertheless, if he wanted to lie and swear that it suffered an unavoidable accident, he would be exempt [from paying] by [taking] an oath. Therefore, when he said "it was stolen" and obligated himself [to pay] the principal, the double payment is acquired by him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:9:1.hebrew: מקנה ליה כפילא - נקנה לו הכפל: כל חיובי ופטורי דארבעה שומרין ילפינן מקראי לקמן בפרק השואל (בבא מציעא דף צד:): שומר חנם ישבע על הכל אם לא פשע, והשואל משלם את הכל. נושא שכר והשוכר פטורין מן האונסין, וחייבין בגניבה ואבידה. שואל פטור במתה מחמת מלאכה הראויה לה, דאמר ליה: להכי אושלת לי, ולא לאוקמה בכילתא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 34a:9:1.english: He transfers the double payment to him - [That is,] the double payment is acquired by him. All the liabilities and exemptions of the four bailees we derive from verses later in the chapter [entitled] HaSho'el (Bava Metzia 94b): An unpaid bailee swears regarding everything [and is exempt] if he was not negligent, and the borrower pays for everything. A paid bailee and a renter are exempt from unavoidable accidents, and are liable for theft and loss. A borrower is exempt when [the animal] died as a result of work that is fitting for it, for he says to him: "For this [purpose] you lent [it] to me, and not to stand it under a canopy."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 34a:11:1.hebrew: שואל עד שישלם - הואיל וכל הנאה שלו. ולהאי טעמא, אפי' אם התנה להיות כש"ח, לא קנה עד שישלם; ולטעמא דלעיל דמשום "לא שכיחא", אם התנה להיות כש"ח, קנה כפל במגו דפטר נפשיה בגניבה ואבידה דשכיחא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 34a:11:1.english: A borrower [acquires it] only when he pays - Since all the benefit is his. And according to this reason, even if he stipulated to be like an unpaid bailee, he does not acquire [the double payment] until he pays; whereas according to the reason above, that it is because [dying due to labor] is "not common," if he stipulated to be like an unpaid bailee, he acquires the double payment, since he could exempt himself [with a claim of] theft or loss, which is common.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 34a:13:1.hebrew: ללישנא קמא דרב פפא ודאי לא הויא תיובתא - דאמר "הריני משלם" לא קנה כפל, אבל שילם — קנה כפל. ור"ח גרס: "ודאי הויא תיובתא", דכיון דרב פפא מפרש טעמא משום דלא שכיח, האי טעמא שייך אפילו בשילם; והא דנקט "ואמר הריני משלם", משום דנקט גבי ש"ח וש"ש, נקט נמי גבי שואל:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 34a:13:1.english: According to the first version of Rav Pappa, [it] certainly is not a conclusive refutation - For [when] he said "I am paying," he did not acquire the double payment, but [when] he paid, he acquired the double payment. And Rabbeinu Chananel reads: "[It] certainly is a conclusive refutation," for since Rav Pappa explains the reason as being because it is uncommon, this reason applies even when he paid; and the reason [the baraita] stated "and he said, 'I am paying'" is because since it stated [that phrasing] regarding an unpaid bailee and a paid bailee, it also stated [it] regarding a borrower.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 34a:1:1.hebrew: דלמא מודה ומפטר - פי': דלמא ימהר להודות קודם שיבאו עדים, והיינו כרב, דאמר: מודה בקנס ואח"כ באו עדים — פטור. ואע"ג דממתני' דמרובה (ב"ק דף עה:) דייקי' דלא כרב: "על פי עצמו דומיא דעל פי עד אחד", לפי מסקנא דהתם דאמר: מסתברא מלתיה דרב בשחייב עצמו בקרן, אבל היכא דפטר עצמו מכלום לא אמר — לא מפקא מדרב. וכן הלכה, ולא כשמואל דמחייב, דר' יוחנן סבר נמי התם דפטור, ושמואל ור' יוחנן — הלכה כר' יוחנן, כדאמר פ' מי שהוציאוהו (עירובין דף מז:):
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 34a:1:1.english: "Perhaps he will confess and be exempted" - This means: perhaps he will hasten to confess before witnesses come. And this is in accordance with Rav, who says: [If one] confesses to a fine and afterward witnesses come, he is exempt. And even though from the Mishnah of Merubah (Bava Kamma 75b) we infer not like Rav, [namely, that confession] "by his own mouth" is analogous to [testimony] "by the mouth of one witness," [nevertheless,] according to the conclusion there, which says: "Rav's statement is reasonable where he obligated himself for the principal, but where he exempted himself from everything he did not say [it]," it does not overturn Rav['s ruling]. And such is the halakhah, and not like Shmuel who holds [him] liable, for R' Yochanan also holds there that he is exempt, and [in a dispute between] Shmuel and R' Yochanan, the halakhah follows R' Yochanan, as stated in the chapter [entitled] Mi Shehotzi'uhu (Eruvin 47b):

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 34a:5:1.hebrew: אי נמי דקיימא באגם - תימה: דנימא נעשה כאמר לו "לכשתגנב ותשלמני, הרי פרתי קנויה לך מעכשיו סמוך לגניבה", דהשתא קני אפילו עומדת באגם — כדאמר ר' יוחנן בפ' האשה שנפלו (כתובות ד' פב. ושם): "משוך פרה זו ותקנה לך מעכשיו ולאחר שלשים יום", קנה אפי' עומדת באגם; וגיזותיה וולדותיה לא קנה אע"פ שאומר "מעכשיו", שאין הקנין נגמר עד סמוך לגניבתה, כדאמר ר' יוחנן בפ' האומר (קידושין דף ס.): "בא אחד וקדשה מעכשיו ולאחר שלשים יום, בא אחר וקדשה מעכשיו ולאחר כ' יום, בא אחר וקדשה מעכשיו ולאחר עשרה ימים, בא אחר וקדשה מעכשיו — אפי' הן מאה, כולם תופסים בה, דכל חד וחד רווחא לחבריה שבק". ושמא י"ל, דקדושין אלימי וכיון דאשכחו רווחא תו לא פקעי; אבל הכא, גיזות וולדות — לכל הפחות הנהו דאיתנהו בשעת מסירה — אהני "מעכשיו" לקנותה סמוך לגניבתה למפרע:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 34a:5:1.english: Alternatively, [a case] where it is standing in a marsh - This is surprising: let us say it is treated as though he said to him, "When it is stolen and you pay me, behold my cow is acquired by you from now, near the theft," for now he acquires [it] even [if] it is standing in a marsh — just as R. Yochanan said in the chapter [entitled] HaIshah SheNaflu (Ketubot 82a, and there [in the parallel]): "[If one says,] 'Pull this cow, and it shall be acquired by you from now and after thirty days,' he acquires [it] even [if] it is standing in a marsh"; and [yet] he does not acquire its fleece and offspring even though he says "from now," because the acquisition is not completed until near its theft, just as R. Yochanan said in the chapter [entitled] HaOmer (Kiddushin 60a): "[If] one came and betrothed her 'from now and after thirty days,' [and] another came and betrothed her 'from now and after twenty days,' [and] another came and betrothed her 'from now and after ten days,' [and] another came and betrothed her 'from now' — even [if] there are a hundred [of them], all of them take effect on her, for each and every one left room for his fellow." And perhaps one can say that betrothal is strong, and once [the subsequent betrothals] found room, they no longer cease; but here, [regarding] fleece and offspring — at the very least [for] those that exist at the time of delivery, "from now" would be effective to acquire it near its theft retroactively [and yet the Gemara implies he acquires no fleece or offspring at all].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 34a:7:1.hebrew: אלא מהא ליכא למשמע מינה - תימה: כיון דקשיא ליה רישא לסיפא, נימא "נעשה", כדאמרינן בפרק קמא דקידושין (דף ה:), ותקשה לר' יוחנן? וי"ל ד"שילם" נקט, לאביי דפרק הגוזל קמא (ב"ק ד' קח.), לאורויי דאם נשבע ושילם דאין הכפל שלו; ולרבא, לאורויי שילם אע"פ שנשבע תחלה שהכפל שלו, ו"לא רצה לישבע" היינו לא רצה לעמוד בשבועה — אבל אם אמר "הריני משלם", אם נשבע תחלה, אין הכפל שלו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 34a:7:1.english: "Rather, no [inference] is to be learned from this [mishna]" - [This is] surprising: since the first clause contradicts the latter clause [for the Gemara], let us say [that] "it is treated as [the alternative]," as we say in the first chapter of Kiddushin (5b), and it would pose a difficulty to Rabbi Yochanan! And one can answer that [the mishna] used [the wording] "he paid" — according to Abaye of the chapter HaGozel Kamma (Bava Kamma 108a) — to teach that if he took an oath and [then] paid, the double payment is not his; and according to Rava, to teach [that if] he paid even though he took an oath first, the double payment is his, and "did not wish to take an oath" means he did not wish to stand by [his] oath — whereas if he [merely] said, "I hereby pay," if he took an oath first, the double payment is not his.
